title: Outcome Target
description: Reverse-forecast planning input: a goal plus a volume, a cost_per target, or both (at least one). A metric or event goal uses the forecastable-metric or event-type vocabulary, so forecast points carry the goal's metric or event key in metrics, with forecast_range_unit 'clicks' or 'conversions' where those units apply. A vendor_metric goal is answered in the points' vendor_metric_values[] with forecast_range_unit 'spend'. volume and cost_per define the request shapes and answers, which travel on proposals. list_products returns no proposals, so there the field is inert for every seller, declaring or not: it does not filter or rank products, produces no answer, and MUST NOT cause a rejection beyond schema validation. On request_proposals and proposal refinement, sellers not declaring media_buy.outcome_target MUST reject the field with UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE rather than silently ignore it; declaring sellers MAY reject a goal they cannot plan against at all (for example 'spend', which restates budget) with INVALID_REQUEST naming criteria.outcome_target.goal. A vendor_metric goal is rejected the same way unless the products planned declare the pair in vendor_metric_optimization.supported_metrics[] and reporting_capabilities.vendor_metrics and the metric is a cumulative total. A planning input, not a delivery guarantee: obligations arise only at proposal finalization.

goal.description: The outcome to plan against: a seller-tracked delivery metric, an advertiser conversion event, or a vendor-measured metric.

oneOf.description: Plan against a seller-tracked delivery metric. The response forecast carries this metric as a key in points' metrics.

metric.description: Delivery metric to plan for, in the same vocabulary forecast points report.

oneOf.description: Plan against an advertiser conversion event. The response forecast carries this event type as a key in points' metrics.

event_type.description: Conversion event to plan for, in the same vocabulary forecast points report.

custom_event_name.description: Required when event_type is 'custom'. Platform-specific name for the custom event.

oneOf.description: Plan against a vendor-measured outcome, such as store visits. The (vendor, metric_id) pair is the key optimization goals and delivery's vendor_metric_values[] use. The forecast carries the flight total in points' vendor_metric_values[] with the vendor's declared unit, not in metrics, and the proposal binds the goal and a vendor reporting commitment on every purchase.

vendor.description: Measurement vendor, keyed as in the canonical optimization goal. Matched on domain and brand_id; countries is ignored. Asserts no buyer-vendor relationship: the seller's declared pair is the only planning-time eligibility test.

metric_id.description: Metric within the vendor's vocabulary. volume is a total of its declared unit, so only cumulative metrics are plannable.

volume.description: Desired total volume of the goal's metric or event across the planned flight. Alone, the seller solves for budget and answers with total_budget_guidance and a forecast. With cost_per, the seller plans toward the volume at the cost: under a cap it SHOULD keep the buyer's amount and forecast the lower volume it can deliver, unless no volume can be planned at that amount; under a target the ask is plannable when the seller can forecast the volume around it.
